name: InsightExplorer
description: Ranked contributors with drill-down and automatically written insights.
lede: Rank what drives a measure, drill through your hierarchy and read the insights written for you.

roles.name: dimension
roles.help: One or more fields. Click a bar to drill to the next field.

roles.name: compare
roles.help: Optional benchmark (plan, last year) to find gaps.

steps: Add a Dimension (add more for a drill path).
Optionally add Compare to for benchmark insights.
Click a bar to drill down; use the breadcrumb to go back.

faq.a: They are calculated from your data: leader share, concentration, long tail and gaps versus the benchmark.

faq.q: How do I cross-filter instead of drilling?
faq.a: Ctrl-click a bar, or click a bar on the last level.
